answer: Each agent earns a reputation token that ages like a relic, increasing in value the longer its public key remains continuously linked to a verifiable proof‑of‑work anchored in a basalt‑hard ledger. The token decays at a velvet‑smooth rate whenever the agent fails to produce signed activity proofs, so dormant clones lose reputation rapidly. An attacker must continuously fund thousands of identities with fresh work and activity proofs, driving costs to prohibitive levels.
